block.createbrewery.speaker: Speaker
createbrewery.amp.align.tip: Sound takes time through the air: far speakers are delayed so everything arrives together.
createbrewery.amp.auto.tip: Finds every linked speaker, sorts it into a zone and sets crossover, delays and levels. Press it whenever you build or change your club.
createbrewery.amp.crossover.tip: Below this the subwoofers play, above it the speakers.
createbrewery.amp.delay.tip: Holds this zone back. Sound travels about one block in 3 ms.
createbrewery.amp.high.tip: Hi-hats and sparkle. Turn it down if it hurts.
createbrewery.amp.hpf.tip: Cuts everything below this frequency. Keeps subwoofers clean (30-40 Hz) and small speakers from booming.
createbrewery.amp.invert.tip: Flips the speaker cone. Try it if the bass gets thinner where two zones meet.
createbrewery.amp.limit.tip: The loudest this zone may get. Lower protects ears in side rooms.
createbrewery.amp.low.tip: Turns the low end of this zone up or down.
createbrewery.amp.master.tip: Volume of the whole club. Turn it down when the light shows red.
createbrewery.amp.power.tip: Switches the whole sound system on and off. Off: speakers and subwoofers go quiet and the lights stop following the music; the DJ still hears the decks at the booth.
createbrewery.amp.preset.custom: Custom settings - press a preset to go back
createbrewery.amp.preset.tip: Ready-made sound: Club for dancing, Live for bands, Background for a bar, Night when it must be quiet. Moving any control afterwards makes it Custom.
createbrewery.amp.readonly: Another amp rack drives this booth (%s %s %s)
createbrewery.amp.reset_hint: Right-click a control to reset it
createbrewery.amp.setup_done: Set up %s speakers and %s subwoofers (%s in side rooms, %s delay)
createbrewery.amp.slope.tip: How sharply subs and speakers are split. 48 is tighter.
createbrewery.amp.status.at_limit: At the limit: a little quieter
createbrewery.amp.status.no_speakers: No speakers linked: right-click the booth with speakers in hand
createbrewery.amp.status.no_subs: No subwoofers on: the bass comes from the speakers
createbrewery.amp.status.unlinked: Not linked: right-click the DJ booth with the rack in hand
createbrewery.amp.zone.tip.0: Speakers that face the dance floor.
createbrewery.amp.zone.tip.1: The subwoofers: the deep bass you feel.
createbrewery.amp.zone.tip.2: Speakers far at the back: they get a delay so they land in step with the front.
createbrewery.amp.zone.tip.3: Speakers behind a wall, like the bar or the toilets: usually quieter.
createbrewery.amp.zone.tip.4: What the DJ hears at the booth.
createbrewery.amp.zones.tip: Click the zone to move this speaker. A = sorted automatically.
createbrewery.cold_spark.auto_on: Cold sparks: fire at the drops
createbrewery.dj.autodrop_hint: Automatic Drop Detection: sends redstone pulse on musical drops
createbrewery.dj.cue_hint: Headphones: hear this deck yourself, whatever the crossfader says (at the booth only)
createbrewery.dj.eq_high.hint: Highs (hats, vocals): left kills them, middle is flat
createbrewery.dj.eq_low.hint: Bass (kick, bassline): left kills it - swap basslines between decks
createbrewery.dj.eq_mid.hint: Mids (synths, snares): left kills them, middle is flat
createbrewery.dj.filter.hint: Filter: left sweeps a low-pass down, right a high-pass up; double-click for off
createbrewery.dj.fx_amount.hint: How much goes into the effect; turn it down and the tail rings out
createbrewery.dj.loop_hint: Loop this many beats; the song runs on underneath (slip). Again to let go
createbrewery.dj.out_of_range: Tempos too far apart for the pitch fader
createbrewery.dj.slip_hint: Slip Mode: Track continues playing underneath scratch, loop, or reverse
createbrewery.dj.tempo_unknown: Both decks need to play a few beats first
createbrewery.dj.vinyl_hint: Vinyl Mode: Scratch and pitch bend with jog wheel
createbrewery.dmx.linked: Fixtures linked to this console - place them around your club
createbrewery.dmx.no_booth: No DJ booth within 16 blocks to record to
createbrewery.dmx.record_hint: Timecode: records your moves to the song playing on the nearest DJ booth, and plays them back whenever that record plays. Shift-click forgets this song's show
createbrewery.dmx.scene_hint: Click: recall scene - Shift-click: store the faders in it
createbrewery.dmx.too_far: No DMX console there, or more than %s blocks away
createbrewery.drink_glass.empty_hint: Empty - right-click beer tap or fill with bottle
createbrewery.hazer.off: Hazer off: the haze clears within a minute
createbrewery.hazer.on: Hazer on: the haze builds up over half a minute
createbrewery.mic.on: Microphone on: talk into it with Simple Voice Chat
createbrewery.mic.on_standalone: Microphone on (standalone) - right-click DJ booth with it in hand
createbrewery.mic.unlinked: Not linked - right-click the DJ booth with it in hand
createbrewery.ponder.brewing_heat.text_1: Brewing requires different heat tiers for different stages of the process.
createbrewery.ponder.brewing_heat.text_2: Mashing (Grist + Water -> Wort) requires standard HEAT (Kindled Blaze Burner).
createbrewery.ponder.brewing_heat.text_3: Boiling (Wort + Hops -> Hopped Wort) requires SUPERHEATED heat (fed with Blaze Cake).
createbrewery.ponder.brewing_heat.text_4: Remember: Mashing needs standard heat, while Boiling hops must be Superheated!
createbrewery.ponder.fermenter.text_1: The Fermenter turns Hopped Wort and Yeast into Beer over time.
createbrewery.ponder.fermenter.text_2: Unlike most Create machines, the Fermenter requires NO shaft or rotational force. It is completely passive.
createbrewery.ponder.fermenter.text_3: Hopped Wort can be piped into the Fermenter from any side.
createbrewery.ponder.fermenter.text_4: Yeast can be inserted with a Funnel or by hand.
createbrewery.ponder.fermenter.text_9: Finished Beer can then be piped out and bottled.
createbrewery.ponder.first_aid.text_1: Someone is unconscious: blackout, K-hole, heart attack, or respiratory failure.
createbrewery.ponder.first_aid.text_2: Crouch directly next to them (Sneak). As long as you stay there: CPR and recovery position keep airways clear.
createbrewery.ponder.first_aid.text_3: Heroin: Naloxone, right-click on the victim. It only lasts about a minute - the heroin returns, so stay with them.
createbrewery.ponder.first_aid.text_4: MDMA and overheating: shade, rest, electrolyte drink instead of chugging plain water.
createbrewery.ponder.first_aid.text_5: Never use alone. Never mix: alcohol with heroin, Xanax, or ketamine halts breathing.
createbrewery.speaker.linked: Linked to this DJ booth - place them around your club
createbrewery.speaker.relinked: Speaker linked to the DJ booth
createbrewery.speaker.too_far: No DJ booth there, or more than %s blocks away
createbrewery.speaker.unlinked: Not linked - right-click a DJ booth with speakers in hand
createbrewery.subwoofer.unlinked: Subwoofer on, but not linked - right-click the DJ booth with subwoofers in hand
death.attack.createbrewery.keta_bladder: %1$s did not survive ketamine bladder syndrome

item.createbrewery.coca_seedling.hint: Only grows in jungles, slowly: takes about 4 days to harvest.
item.createbrewery.grape_cutting.hint: On grass, dirt, or farmland in the sun. Once picked, the vine regrows.
item.createbrewery.hemp_seeds.hint: On hydrated farmland under high light (sun or lamps). Half turn out male: remove them early before they pollinate females.
item.createbrewery.mushroom_spores.hint: On mycelium, podzol, or moss in the dark. Three harvests before the patch is depleted.
item.createbrewery.naloxon.desc1: Emergency nasal spray for opioid overdoses
item.createbrewery.naloxon.desc2: Right-click on unconscious players or yourself
item.createbrewery.naloxon.desc3: Triggers immediate withdrawal in opioid dependents
item.createbrewery.opium_poppy_seeds.hin: On hydrated farmland in full sun.
item.createbrewery.peyote_pup.hint: On sand, in deserts or badlands under the sun. Very slow; the button regrows after harvesting.
jei.createbrewery.info.dmt:
DMT (one deep hit): breakthrough in seconds - waiting room, entities, the beyond, return. Under one minute.

Risks: completely out of body, physical form left defenseless. Sit down, have a trip sitter.

Dangerous with: anything that strains cardiovascular system.

First Aid: Unconscious, heart attack, or choking on vomit - crouch directly beside the victim (Sneak): CPR and recovery position keep airways clear.
jei.createbrewery.info.drug_test_kit:
Drug Test Kit: Hold drug in off-hand, then use. Reveals batch potency and tests for fentanyl. Street supply is never what it promises: coke is usually cut, pills vary from weak to dangerously strong, mushrooms vary with nature. Every stack is its own batch.

Very strong: take half. Fentanyl: do not take - a single dose can stop breathing.
jei.createbrewery.info.electrolyte_drink: Electrolyte Drink: Salts and sugars. Counteracts hyponatremia and overheating on MDMA, quenches thirst (with Tough As Nails).
jei.createbrewery.info.heroin:
Heroin (syringe): warm rush, nodding off, dreamscape. About 4 minutes.

Risks: respiratory depression, rapid tolerance and dependence (withdrawal), seizures.

Dangerous with: alcohol and Xanax (fatal respiratory arrest), cocaine or meth (speedball: upper masks overdose).

Street heroin may contain fentanyl - test first with Drug Test Kit. Naloxone reverses overdoses.

Naloxone saves lives: right-click on the victim.

First Aid: Unconscious, heart attack, or choking on vomit - crouch directly beside the victim (Sneak): CPR and recovery position keep airways clear.
jei.createbrewery.info.joint:
Joint (six drags): relaxed, giggles, munchies, warm green glow. About 4 minutes.

Risks: cottonmouth, greening out from too much (collapse, vomiting), paranoia.

Dangerous with: alcohol before (greening out), psychedelics (amplifies intensity, bad trips), ketamine.

First Aid: Unconscious, heart attack, or choking on vomit - crouch directly beside the victim (Sneak): CPR and recovery position keep airways clear.
jei.createbrewery.info.keta:
Ketamine (snort line): cotton head, world drifts away, numb body. About 2 minutes.

Risks: K-hole after 3 lines - paralyzed, dissociated. Long-term bladder damage.

Dangerous with: alcohol (blackout), cannabis (K-hole after 2 lines), opioids, and Xanax (breathing).

First Aid: Unconscious, heart attack, or choking on vomit - crouch directly beside the victim (Sneak): CPR and recovery position keep airways clear.
jei.createbrewery.info.koks:
Cocaine (snort line): alert, fast, talkative, sharp and bright. About 3 minutes.

Risks: tachycardia, heart attack, nosebleed, compulsive redosing; skin picking after 3 lines. Each line feels weaker but strains the heart just as hard.

Dangerous with: alcohol (cocaethylene: longer, harder on the heart), heroin (speedball), ketamine (CK-mix), meth.

First Aid: Unconscious, heart attack, or choking on vomit - crouch directly beside the victim (Sneak): CPR and recovery position keep airways clear.
jei.createbrewery.info.lachgas_balloon:
Nitrous Oxide (balloon): auditory flange (wah-wah), laughing, dissociation for seconds. About 15 seconds.

Risks: chained balloons cause hypoxia, blackouts, falling injuries.

Dangerous with: psychedelics (peak storming), near cliffs or edges.

First Aid: Unconscious, heart attack, or choking on vomit - crouch directly beside the victim (Sneak): CPR and recovery position keep airways clear.
jei.createbrewery.info.lsd:
LSD (blotter): slow onset, then geometric patterns, breathing walls, color enhancement, trails. About 12 minutes.

Risks: bad trip in dark or loud environments, flashbacks, 24h psychedelic tolerance.

Dangerous with: cannabis (bad trip), nitrous oxide (peak storming), MDMA (candyflip: warmer, stronger).

First Aid: Unconscious, heart attack, or choking on vomit - crouch directly beside the victim (Sneak): CPR and recovery position keep airways clear.
jei.createbrewery.info.magic_mushroom:
Magic Mushrooms (chew): like LSD, but organic, earthy and in waves; stomach nausea. About 6 minutes.

Risks: nausea (worse on full stomach), bad trip, silent darkness during heroic doses.

Dangerous with: cannabis, nitrous, MDMA - similar to LSD.

First Aid: Unconscious, heart attack, or choking on vomit - crouch directly beside the victim (Sneak): CPR and recovery position keep airways clear.
jei.createbrewery.info.mdma:
MDMA (pill): warmth, empathy, music moves through body, euphoria, dancing. About 6 minutes, followed by comedown. Takes longer after food, faster on empty stomach. Pill strength varies wildly - test, split strong pills.

Risks: overheating from dancing, jaw clenching; too much plain water = hyponatremia. Take breaks, find shade, drink electrolytes instead of plain water.

Dangerous with: alcohol (dehydration: overheats much faster), cocaine, meth.

First Aid: Unconscious, heart attack, or choking on vomit - crouch directly beside the victim (Sneak): CPR and recovery position keep airways clear.
jei.createbrewery.info.meth:
Crystal Meth (snort/smoke): hyper-focused, driven, lasts for hours. About 12 minutes.

Risks: cardiac strain, hyperthermia, sleep-deprivation psychosis - shadows, voices, delusions. Only sleep helps.

Dangerous with: heroin (speedball), cocaine, MDMA, alcohol.

First Aid: Unconscious, heart attack, or choking on vomit - crouch directly beside the victim (Sneak): CPR and recovery position keep airways clear.
jei.createbrewery.info.naloxon:
Naloxone (nasal spray): Antidote for opioid overdoses. Right-click on unconscious victim - cannot self-administer if not breathing. Lasts about 1 minute; heroin remains in system and can re-depress breathing.

First Aid: Unconscious, heart attack, or choking on vomit - crouch directly beside the victim (Sneak): CPR and recovery position keep airways clear.
jei.createbrewery.info.peyote:
Peyote (chew button, bitter): desert colors, spirit guide, long calm journey. About 12 minutes.

Risks: heavy nausea/purging during onset, bad trip.

Dangerous with: cannabis, nitrous - similar to LSD.

First Aid: Unconscious, heart attack, or choking on vomit - crouch directly beside the victim (Sneak): CPR and recovery position keep airways clear.
jei.createbrewery.info.space_brownie:
Space Brownie: Edible cannabis - delayed onset, hits hard and lasts long. Do not redose early thinking it failed.

Risks: intense greening out, panic, nausea.

First Aid: Unconscious, heart attack, or choking on vomit - crouch directly beside the victim (Sneak): CPR and recovery position keep airways clear.
jei.createbrewery.info.xanax:
Xanax (pill): calm, anxiety erased, sensory dampening. About 5 minutes, followed by rebound anxiety.

Fake black market bars often contain fentanyl - test first.

Risks: rebound panic, seizures upon abrupt cessation after tolerance develops.

Dangerous with: heroin and alcohol (breathing).

First Aid: Unconscious, heart attack, or choking on vomit - crouch directly beside the victim (Sneak): CPR and recovery position keep airways clear.
